close_reason: Fixed: replaced sig_alg == &SHA1_WITH_RSA || sig_alg == &ECDSA_WITH_SHA1 with matches!(sig_alg, SHA1_WITH_RSA | ECDSA_WITH_SHA1)
description: pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs:179 — 'if sig_alg == &SHA1_WITH_RSA || sig_alg == &ECDSA_WITH_SHA1' compares a &&ObjectIdentifier against &ObjectIdentifier constants via auto-ref. The idiomatic Rust form is either 'if *sig_alg == SHA1_WITH_RSA || *sig_alg == ECDSA_WITH_SHA1' or 'if matches!(*sig_alg, SHA1_WITH_RSA | ECDSA_WITH_SHA1)'. The &CONST form works but reads as though address comparison is intended; a senior reviewer will flag it.
title: R4: cabf_tls_br.rs: compare OID directly, not via &CONST
